title: recover-Q: (6,2) STNFS, twisted C4 base field, run gate: expected 2^114.575435933193

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, uniform challenges and fresh coins, proof.md's algorithm returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 at expected total work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^115.7392649150+2^66) < 2^114.575435933193 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); every run below 2^115.739264915001 units. The coin is part of the one cold attack on the one target: the run reads one fresh 64-bit coin before any other work, then stops at the charged closed-gate cost (a failure) or, with probability K/2^64, performs the whole attack; K=8233268698497053251 is least with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39, lo_run=0.8738 the opened run's success bound under H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT. The work is that one run's expected total work; nothing is amortized over other targets or runs.
